text:
Sam K: Pushed a quick dendrogram-based sanity scan for the new small embed model (shimmer-v1). Notebook + viz here: https://internal/notebooks/shimmer-dendro.ipynb :mag:
Anya R: Nice. What anchor/holdout split did you use?
Liam P: anchors=2k, holdout=10k. Ran a lightweight run on a 10k sample first.
Maya S: Cophenetic corr is kinda low (~0.72) on the short-tail cohort, clusters look noisy in the top-level cut.
EvalBot: job 4350000000 finished: avg cosine sim matrix computed (10kx2k) in 12m 34s. Logs: /artifacts/4350000000/log.txt
Sam K: command I used: `./scripts/dendro_scan.sh --model shimmer-v1 --anchors 2000 --holdout 10000 --metric cosine`
Liam P: quick metrics from the run: recall@1: 0.62, recall@5: 0.83, recall@10: 0.90. silhouette (avg): 0.18, ARI: 0.44.
Anya R: recall@1 looks lower than our baseline (0.68) — any obvious mismatch in preprocessing?
Maya S: found: whitespace/token-normalization mismatch on multilingual anchors. Whitening step improved cophenetic -> 0.86 and recall@1 -> 0.66 in a small rerun.
Sam K: interesting. So whitening helps, but still a gap. Could be model capacity on lexical variants. Plan: run 5 seeds x 3 anchor diversities (1k/2k/5k) + whitening toggle.
Liam P: + also try L2-normalized dot (inner product with vectors normalized) vs raw cosine implementation — tiny implementation diffs have bitten us before.
Anya R: can we add a dendrogram heatmap artifact to the pipeline? the UMAP+dendro combo was helpful visually.
Sam K: will add heatmap PNG and cophenetic corr to artifacts. If we get cophenetic > 0.88 and recall@1 >= 0.67 across seeds, we consider shimmer-v1 ok for broader holdout.
Maya S: also flag long-tail noisy queries for manual inspection (I can annotate 200 samples).
Sam K: sweet. I'll kick off the sweep tonight and post aggregated table. cc @Liam P @Anya R :thumbsup:
